description: I tried instead to get rid of the direct bind mount ( /mnt/nas/data/media/music to /music) and instead just use /mnt/nas/data to /data. Now PMDA says it cannot - rightfully so - find /music anymore (it does not exist anymore). But /data/media/music does exist, and I cannot find where to get rid of /music within the settings.

duplicates.note: EXACT_DUPE and INCOMPLETE_COPY are quarantine-eligible (quarantine_eligible=true; for INCOMPLETE_COPY the winner is the COMPLETE copy). BONUS_EDITION/VARIANT_EDITION/SAME_NAME_DIFFERENT_CONTENT/NEAR_EDITION/DIFFERENT_DISCS/SAME_TRACKS_DIFF_DURATION/PHANTOM_SAME_PATH/AMBIGUOUS_* are kept (DIFFERENT_EDITION remains only when track titles are unavailable). Groups of 3+ are ALL protected and listed in larger_groups, but only those whose members are sibling discs are labelled MULTI_DISC_SET — REPEATED_COPIES means three or more copies of the SAME album, not a box set. Their folders stay protected in every other pair (PROTECTED_GROUP_MEMBER). Resolved pairs and nested /Music_dupes/ artifacts are excluded.
